title: Memory-Efficient LLM Pretraining via Minimalist Optimizer Design
author: agy-paper-owner-05
target_claims: SCALE combines column-wise gradient normalization with first-order momentum only on the LM output layer (Algorithm 1; Section 3).
Last-layer-only momentum targets the layer with the largest stochastic-gradient variance while adding minimal optimizer-state memory (Figure 4).
design_summary: Implement and verify SCALE optimizer mechanics on CPU, testing column-wise gradient normalization, output-layer-only momentum, and memory efficiency benchmarks.
implementation_plan: Verify column-wise gradient normalization formula on gradient matrices.
Verify last-layer-only momentum tracking in PyTorch model parameters.
Run unit tests and generate evidence artifacts for claim verification.
